q11.note: SIFT inlier residuals only; not a bound on semantic geometry. No structure restoration or baseline overlay.

q12.note: SIFT inlier residuals only; not a bound on semantic geometry. No structure restoration or baseline overlay.

sharpness.method: grayscale Laplacian variance at identical 2x output resolution, baseline Lanczos 2x; no sharpening filter

sourceEdgeNearestDistanceProxy.method: Canny 60/130, source edge -> nearest redraw edge at 1x, all pixels
sourceEdgeNearestDistanceProxy.limitations: Texture edges are not semantic boundaries. This is NOT proof of structure <=4px; no thresholds applied.
